name: sOU Default HUD
releaseNotes:
- Unify HUD status, killfeed, round-history, utility and ammunition icons with a local Lucide/custom outline system. Keep original weapon, knife and C4 silhouettes.
- Apply consistent team-colored card icons, white text and equipment exceptions, and green money amounts with a team-colored dollar sign. Color all round-result icons by the winning side, including C4 and defuse kits.
- Improve the observer strip with a larger white weapon and separate loaded-rounds/reserve icons on the existing lower row. Omit unavailable ammunition and show armor directly left of health.
- Fix Bahnschrift Condensed selection in Firefox and Chromium, health-fill proportions outside the observer-slot strip, slot/name alignment, and mirrored skull cropping on dead cards.
- Animate the neutral-blue MVP card with a proportional gap below the matchbar. Keep it visible for up to eight seconds, ending early at the next freeze, including during pauses and after match end.
- Expand the Debug preview with all supported killfeed icons, winner-colored round results, varied utility and armor examples. Preserve production SDK subscriptions and dynamic radar drawing.
- Requires sOU desktop 0.3.34 or newer. Select version 0.4.22 and reopen outputs after importing.
